_comment: CI is one job, 'checks' (.github/workflows/ci.yml); required_ci lists its check steps. CI job env: GOOGLE_API_KEY=ci-placeholder SECRET_KEY=ci-placeholder-secret-key-0123456789abcdef SESSION_HTTPS_ONLY=false TZ=UTC (README: run locally with the same env, without .env). Setup step: uv sync --frozen --extra dev --python 3.12. Review: the user reviews each PR manually after it is opened, so require_review stays false (decided 2026-11-25). E2E: no command by decision; live browser E2E is manual (README 'live 검사 (수동)'). JS browser checks run inside test-ratchet (README '브라우저(JS) 검사').

branch_protection.source: gh api -X PUT repos/DomineYH/elp_gemini/branches/main/protection (2026-11-25): required check 'checks' (GitHub Actions), strict false, no review requirement, enforce_admins false
